svg.text: Klondike sled: side stiffness study (2026-10-13). Left side from outside; inches; +x forward (the bow is on the right).
Outside the hull is unchanged except for options A and C (stiles) and the E bolt heads. Hidden inside parts are dashed. Default params (D-57, D-66, D-73).
a knee there hits the seat cushion
58-3/4" between the transom and the bulkhead (the web is in stopped dados at both ends)
today's lash points (screwed doublers, all in the rear half)
option E: rib with a 2" head, D-ring through-bolted (4 dots = bolts)
inside parts (box, cushion, grab board), hidden
Softest spot today: 50 lbf at the gunwale near x = 5 to 7 moves it
0.17 to 0.27" (the box ends and the grab board starts there).
Sections through the left side, looking forward (outside on the left, inboard on the right). Scale 26 px per inch.
D. Tie to the storage box
x = 5.9, by the box's fore end

Bands: 0.2075" white oak on each face of the 0.21" white oak ply web (sandwich 5/8"); chine and gunwale bands 1-1/2" tall; the deck edge tucks under the inner chine band. Rail 3/4" x 3" under the chine.

Recommended: D + E (green). The E rib at 27.6 and the box tie at 5.9 make the side feel solid (50 lbf moves the gunwale 1/16" at most) and carry the 300 lbf D-ring rating; A (orange) is a look, not a stiffener.
Old lash points: x = -4.5, 6.9, 18.9 (all behind the seat front). New: x = 5.9, 27.6, 44 per side, spread over the whole bed.
